responses: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Tap-to-Pay, cash, and Smart Retail Store Credit.
All major credit/debit cards, contactless NFC payments (Apple/Google Pay), and gift cards are supported at checkout.

patterns: Is cotton organic and ethically sourced?
responses: 100% of our apparel line uses GOTS-certified organic cotton and recycled polyester. We are committed to 100% carbon-neutral shipping and eco-friendly recyclable packaging.

patterns: What is the smart fitting room?

patterns: If price drops after purchase can I get a refund?
responses: Yes! We offer a 14-Day Price Match Guarantee against major retail competitors and will refund the difference if an item's price drops within 14 days of purchase.

patterns: Are you hiring at retail stores?

responses: We're always looking for passionate retail associates, store managers, and AI software engineers! Explore open opportunities on our Careers page at smartretail.ai/careers.
Submit your resume online to join our growing retail technology team!

patterns: How is my facial recognition data used?
Data privacy policy for biometric data

responses: Your privacy is our highest priority. Facial encodings are 100% encrypted, stored locally as anonymized vector hashes, never sold to third parties, and customers can opt out at any time.

patterns: When is the next clearance sale?
